mapper.select: select a.*,IF(c.ID is not null,c.`NAME`,a.orgName) as orgName, IF(d.ID is not null,d.`NAME`,a.position) as `position` from (select '总部' as userType, ID as id,`NAME` as userName,DEPT_ID as orgId,DUTY_ID as positionId,`STATUS` as status,DEPT as orgName,DUTY as `position`, SEX as sex,ID_NUMBER as idCardNumber,BIRTH as birthDay,PHONE as phone,HIRE_DATE as hireDate,POSITIVE_TIME as positiveTime, USER_ID as userId,LEAVE_DATE as leaveDate from PERSONNEL where DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' union all select '分公司' as userType, ID as id,`NAME` as userName,DEPT_ID as orgId,DUTY_ID as positionId,HR_STATUS as status,DEPT as orgName,DUTY as `position`, SEX as sex,ID_NUMBER as idCardNumber,BIRTH as birthDay,PHONE as phone,HIRE_DATE as hireDate,POSITIVE_TIME as positiveTime, null as userId,RESIGNATION_TIME as leaveDate from HR_SUB_PERSONNEL where DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE'and `STATUS` in ('0', '1')) a LEFT JOIN SYS_ORG c ON a.orgId = c.ID LEFT JOIN SYS_POSITION d ON a.positionId = d.ID
